Having done this ground work, we now formally define our main object of study.

Definition 2.5. An (r x c,v)-near triple array is a binary (near) equireplicate r x c row-column design on v symbols in which

- any row and column have either Are or Xe common symbols,
- any two rows have either A, or ›, common symbols,
- any two columns have either ›e or ›e common symbols.

Note that the definition allows a near triple array to be equireplicate. To avoid having to calculate the quantities involved in the definition explicitly, it will often be convenient to instead use the following alternative characterization of near triple arrays.
